text_nat: Installing a lamp at home is a process that requires caution, knowledge, and the right tools, such as a screwdriver, pliers, and a wire stripper. Before starting, it's essential to cut off the electricity supply at the main panel to avoid accidents, shocks, or short circuits. Once the area is secured, proceed to identify the wires: the live wire (brown, black, or gray), the neutral wire (blue), and the ground wire (green-yellow), always following the manufacturer's instructions or those of a professional electrician. The lamp support must be fixed to the ceiling or wall with anchors, screws, and washers, ensuring its stability and safety. Finally, connect the corresponding wires to the lamp's terminal block, check the fastening of the lampshade, bulb, or screen, and restore electricity to verify proper functioning, light, and power-on.

text_nat: Last week I decided it was time to install a new lamp in my living room, a task that always generates a certain apprehension, doubt, and nervousness in me. For this, I prepared all the tools: the drill, the anchors, and the screws, in addition to the lamp itself, of course. I climbed the ladder with a mix of excitement, fear, and concentration, knowing that safety is 1st in these endeavors. I disconnected the power, checking with a tester that no electricity was reaching it, that there were no sparks or short circuits. Then, with the help of my father—a handyman all his life—we measured, marked, and drilled the necessary holes in the ceiling, a delicate process that requires patience, precision, and a steady hand. We connected the phase, neutral, and ground wires, following the instructions, verifying that everything was well adjusted, without looseness or false contacts. Finally, we screwed the lamp to the ceiling, climbed down from the ladder, and, with a mix of relief, pride, and satisfaction, I turned on the switch and the light illuminated the room, creating a cozy, modern, and functional atmosphere.

La salsa mejora la forma física, la confianza y la interacción social, siendo una actividad que ofrece múltiples beneficios, tanto corporales como emocionales y relacionales. Es un baile que permite expresarse con libertad, pasión y alegría, invitando a sus practicantes a sentir la música con el cuerpo, el alma y el corazón. A través de la salsa se forman amistades, se descubren nuevas culturas y se vive la vida de una manera más intensa, plena y vibrante.

topic: cambiar el aceite de la moto
text_es: Cambiar el aceite de la moto es una tarea de mantenimiento crucial para asegurar su buen funcionamiento y prolongar la vida útil del motor, protegiendo sus componentes internos del desgaste, la fricción y la corrosión. Este proceso, que puede variar ligeramente según el modelo y el fabricante de la moto, generalmente implica drenar el aceite viejo, sustituir el filtro y rellenar con aceite nuevo de la viscosidad y calidad adecuadas, como 10W-40, 15W-50 o 20W-50. Es fundamental seguir las recomendaciones del fabricante respecto a los intervalos de cambio, que suelen ser cada 3000, 5000 o 6000 kilómetros, o cada 6, 9 o 12 meses, lo que ocurra 1.º, dependiendo del tipo de conducción, clima y uso de la moto, ya sea en ciudad, carretera o terrenos difíciles. Para llevarlo a cabo, se necesitan herramientas básicas como una llave de drenaje, un embudo y un recipiente para el aceite usado, y también un trapo, guantes y gafas de seguridad. Un cambio de aceite regular evita la acumulación de sedimentos, mejora la lubricación y ayuda a mantener una temperatura óptima, contribuyendo a un rendimiento eficiente, suave y fiable del vehículo.

text_nat: Yesterday I decided it was time to change the oil in my old motorcycle—a Honda CB500X—a task that always generates a mix of excitement, nervousness, and pride in me. 1st, I prepared all the tools: the filter wrench, the drain pan, and the old, dirty rags. text_nat: To assemble a large puzzle, like one with 1000 or 2000 pieces, patience, organization, and strategy are key. Before starting, clear a large, well-lit, and stable surface, ideally a table, a board, or the floor. The 1st step is to sort the pieces by color, shape, and texture, looking for distinguishable edges, corners, or sections. The edges are always the 1st challenge, so focus on finding them, joining them, and forming the outer frame. Afterward, group the pieces according to their patterns, shades, and thematic elements, for example, a sky, a building, or a tree. It's useful to work in small sections, completing one area and then moving to the next, gradually combining the parts. Don't get frustrated if you don't see immediate progress; take breaks, stretch, and come back with a fresh mind. Enjoy the assembly process, the relaxation, and the final satisfaction of seeing the complete image.

text_es: Hacer velas en casa es una actividad creativa, relajante y gratificante que permite personalizar el ambiente. Se necesita una cera adecuada, mechas y un recipiente para comenzar, eligiendo entre cera de soja, parafina o abeja. El proceso implica fundir la cera, añadir colorantes, esencias y otros aditivos, como aceites, purpurina y flores secas. Es crucial calentar la cera a la temperatura correcta para asegurar una quema uniforme y evitar imperfecciones, burbujas o grietas. Una vez lista, se vierte cuidadosamente en el recipiente con la mecha ya centrada, dejando que se enfríe de forma gradual, lenta y sin corrientes de aire. Las velas caseras no solo decoran, sino que también perfuman el hogar y son excelentes regalos para amigos, familiares o vecinos. Además, se pueden experimentar con diferentes moldes, diseños y texturas, lo que convierte esta afición en un arte, una terapia y una oportunidad de negocio.

Once ready, it's carefully poured into the container with the wick already centered, allowing it to cool gradually, slowly, and without drafts. Homemade candles not only decorate but also perfume the home and make excellent gifts for friends, family, or neighbors. Additionally, you can experiment with different molds, designs, and textures, which turns this hobby into an art, a therapy, and a business opportunity.

text_es: Para cuidar un jardín de rosas con éxito, 1.º, elige un lugar soleado, aireado y bien drenado. Asegúrate de regar las rosas con regularidad, especialmente durante los meses más cálidos y secos, proporcionándoles un riego profundo, constante y sin encharcamientos. Fertiliza cada 4 a 6 semanas con un abono equilibrado, rico en nitrógeno, fósforo y potasio, para promover un crecimiento vigoroso y una floración abundante. Poda anualmente para dar forma a las plantas, eliminar ramas muertas, enfermas o dañadas, y fomentar la producción de nuevas flores. Controla plagas como pulgones, araña roja y hongos, aplicando tratamientos orgánicos o químicos según la necesidad para mantener tus rosales sanos y vistosos. Con estos cuidados básicos —sol, agua y nutrientes— tus rosas florecerán espléndidamente, ofreciendo belleza, aroma y color a tu jardín.

text_nat: To successfully care for a rose garden, 1st, choose a sunny, airy, and well-drained spot. Make sure to water the roses regularly, especially during the warmer and drier months, providing them with deep, consistent watering without waterlogging. Fertilize every 4 to 6 weeks with a balanced fertilizer, rich in nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium, to promote vigorous growth and abundant flowering. Prune annually to shape the plants, remove dead, diseased, or damaged branches, and encourage the production of new flowers. Control pests such as aphids, spider mites, and fungi, applying organic or chemical treatments as needed to keep your rose bushes healthy and showy. With these basic cares—sun, water, and nutrients—your roses will bloom splendidly, offering beauty, aroma, and color to your garden.

El equipo necesario incluye esquís, bastones y botas, aunque también es fundamental llevar ropa térmica, guantes y gafas para protegerse del frío, del viento y del sol. Las 1.as sesiones suelen realizarse en pistas verdes o azules, zonas con poca pendiente, suaves y seguras. Con práctica constante, se adquiere confianza, destreza y rapidez, permitiendo explorar terrenos más desafiantes. Es importante recordar que la seguridad en la montaña es primordial; siempre se deben respetar las normas, los límites y las señales. Esquiar no solo mejora la condición física, sino que también ofrece la oportunidad de disfrutar de paisajes nevados, únicos y espectaculares.

text_nat: Learning to ski is an exciting experience, combining sport, nature, and fun. It requires patience, balance, and coordination, key elements for gliding smoothly down the slopes. Ideally, one should start with lessons taught by qualified instructors, who will teach the basic techniques: braking, turning, and falling correctly. The necessary equipment includes skis, poles, and boots, although it's also essential to wear thermal clothing, gloves, and goggles to protect against the cold, wind, and sun. The 1st sessions are usually held on green or blue slopes, areas with little incline, that are gentle and safe. With constant practice, one gains confidence, skill, and speed, allowing them to explore more challenging terrains. It's important to remember that safety in the mountains is paramount; one must always respect the rules, limits, and signs. Skiing not only improves physical condition but also offers the opportunity to enjoy unique and spectacular snowy landscapes.

The necessary equipment includes skis, poles and boots, although it's also essential to wear thermal clothing, gloves and goggles to protect against the cold, wind and sun. The 1st sessions are usually held on green or blue slopes, areas with little incline, that are gentle and safe. With constant practice, one gains confidence, skill and speed, allowing them to explore more challenging terrains. It's important to remember that safety in the mountains is paramount; one must always respect the rules, limits and signs. Skiing not only improves physical condition but also offers the opportunity to enjoy unique and spectacular snowy landscapes.

text_es: Mi 1.ª vez aprendiendo a esquiar fue un desastre cómico, pero memorable. Recuerdo la ilusión, el frío y la nieve recién caída. El instructor, un hombre alto, simpático y muy paciente, nos dio las instrucciones básicas: cómo ponernos los esquís, cómo caer y cómo levantarnos. Empecé en la pista de principiantes, que era suave, ancha y sin obstáculos. Mis piernas se sentían como gelatina, torpes, descoordinadas y con vida propia. Me caí una y otra vez, rodando por la nieve como un muñeco, riendo, jadeando y con la ropa empapada. Pero cada vez que me levantaba, sentía una pequeña victoria, una mezcla de orgullo, alivio y determinación. Al final del día, pude deslizarme unos metros sin caerme, lo cual fue un logro tremendo, inesperado y gratificante.

text_nat: My 1st time learning to ski was a comical, but memorable, disaster. I remember the excitement, the cold, and the freshly fallen snow. The instructor, a tall, friendly, and very patient man, gave us the basic instructions: how to put on our skis, how to fall, and how to get up. I started on the beginner slope, which was gentle, wide, and without obstacles. My legs felt like jelly, clumsy, uncoordinated, and with a life of their own. I fell again and again, rolling through the snow like a doll, laughing, gasping, and with my clothes soaked. But every time I got up, I felt a small victory, a mix of pride, relief, and determination. At the end of the day, I was able to slide a few meters without falling, which was a tremendous, unexpected, and gratifying achievement.

Al principio, elige pistas fáciles, anchas y con poca pendiente, para que puedas practicar sin agobios ni estrés. No te olvides de la seguridad: lleva siempre casco, gafas de sol y ropa adecuada para protegerte del frío, el viento y la nieve. Recuerda que el progreso es gradual, así que celebra cada pequeño avance, cada bajada controlada y cada nuevo giro. text_es: Organizar una excursión escolar implica una planificación detallada, considerando la edad de los estudiantes, el objetivo pedagógico y los recursos disponibles. 1.º, se debe definir el destino —un museo, un parque natural o una ciudad histórica— y la fecha, procurando que coincida con el calendario académico y evitar festivos. La logística abarca la reserva del transporte, el alojamiento y las actividades programadas, así como la asignación de responsabilidades a los acompañantes, que deben estar preparados para cualquier eventualidad, emergencia o imprevisto. Además, es fundamental establecer un presupuesto claro que cubra todos los gastos —transporte, entradas y comidas— y comunicarlo a las familias con suficiente antelación, ofreciendo opciones de pago si es posible. text_es: Hacer mermelada de fresa es un proceso delicioso y gratificante que transforma la fruta fresca en una conserva dulce. 1.º, se seleccionan fresas maduras, sanas y sin golpes; se lavan con cuidado, se les quita el tallo y se trocean al gusto, grandes, medianas o pequeñas. Después, se mezclan las fresas con azúcar, zumo de limón y, opcionalmente, pectina; estos ingredientes son fundamentales para la textura, el sabor y la conservación. La mezcla se cocina a fuego medio-bajo, removiendo constantemente para evitar que se pegue o se queme; este paso puede durar entre 20 y 40 minutos, dependiendo de la cantidad de fruta y la consistencia deseada. Se sabe que está lista cuando alcanza una temperatura de 104 ºC o cuando una pequeña porción se solidifica en un plato frío. Finalmente, la mermelada caliente se vierte en tarros esterilizados, herméticos y limpios, se cierran bien y se dejan enfriar boca abajo para crear un vacío que asegure su conservación. Así se obtiene una mermelada casera, perfecta para desayunos, postres y meriendas.

anchors: azúcar, zumo de limón y, opcionalmente, pectina
la textura, el sabor y la conservación

text_nat: Making strawberry jam is a delicious and rewarding process that transforms fresh fruit into a sweet preserve. 1st, ripe, healthy, and unbruised strawberries are selected; they're carefully washed, stemmed, and chopped to taste—large, medium, or small. Afterward, the strawberries are mixed with sugar, lemon juice, and, optionally, pectin; these ingredients are essential for texture, flavor, and preservation. The mixture is cooked over medium-low heat, stirring constantly to prevent it from sticking or burning; this step can last between 20 and 40 minutes, depending on the amount of fruit and the desired consistency. It's known to be ready when it reaches a temperature of 104 ºC or when a small portion solidifies on a cold plate. Finally, the hot jam is poured into sterilized, airtight, and clean jars, sealed tightly, and left to cool upside down to create a vacuum that ensures its preservation. This is how homemade jam is obtained, perfect for breakfasts, desserts, and snacks.

text_es: Aprender a hacer croquetas es un arte culinario que combina técnica, paciencia y creatividad. El proceso comienza con la bechamel, la base esencial que debe ser suave, cremosa y sin grumos, lograda con harina, mantequilla y leche. Para conseguir la textura perfecta, es crucial cocinar la masa a fuego medio, removiendo constante y enérgicamente hasta que se despegue de las paredes, logrando así un punto óptimo de espesor, sabor y consistencia. Después, se añade el ingrediente principal —jamón, pollo o setas— picado finamente, para integrar bien los sabores y evitar que queden trozos grandes. Una vez fría, la masa se moldea en la forma deseada —ovalada, redonda o alargada— y se procede al empanado. Este consiste en pasar las croquetas por harina, huevo batido y pan rallado, asegurando una cobertura uniforme, crujiente y dorada. Finalmente, se fríen en aceite abundante y muy caliente, hasta que estén doradas, crujientes y deliciosas, listas para disfrutar como entrante, tapa o plato principal.

text_nat: Starting a stamp collection, or philately, is a rewarding hobby that combines history, art, and geography. One can start in various ways, such as inheriting old albums, buying starter lots, or receiving stamps from letters, postcards, and packages. Collectors often specialize by country, theme, or era, looking for stamps from Spain, France, or Germany, for example, or collections of animals, flowers, or sports. It's essential to acquire basic tools like tweezers, a magnifying glass, and a catalog to properly identify and preserve the pieces. Organization is key, using stock books, albums, or transparent sleeves to protect stamps from humidity, light, and dust. Many find enjoyment in researching, cataloging, and exchanging with other philatelists, learning about the motifs, printing, and circulation of each specimen. With patience and dedication, a modest collection can grow in value, beauty, and interest.

text_es: Elegir las zapatillas para correr adecuadas es crucial para prevenir lesiones, mejorar el rendimiento y garantizar la comodidad durante el ejercicio. No te dejes llevar únicamente por la estética, el precio o la marca; la funcionalidad, la protección y el confort deben ser tus prioridades. text_nat: Choosing the right running shoes is crucial for preventing injuries, improving performance, and ensuring comfort during exercise. It's essential to consider the type of foot strike—neutral, pronator, or supinator—the usual running surface—asphalt, track, or trail—and the frequency, intensity, and duration of the sessions. Experts recommend visiting specialized stores where they can perform a foot strike analysis and offer advice on models, brands, and cushioning technologies. It's important to try on shoes at the end of the day, with your usual socks, and walk, jog, or run a little in them to evaluate the support, fit, and overall feel. Don't be guided solely by aesthetics, price, or brand; functionality, protection, and comfort should be your priorities. A good choice can make the difference between a pleasant experience and one full of discomfort, pain, or injuries.

text_nat: I remember my 1st time choosing running shoes as if it were yesterday; it was quite an odyssey, an adventure, a challenge. I had heard advice from friends, coaches, and salespeople, but the truth is that the final decision rested on me, my foot, and my running style. I entered the store and was greeted by a kind, patient, and very expert salesperson, who guided me through the athletic shoe section. He explained the importance of foot strike type (pronator, supinator, or neutral), the mileage I planned to do, and the terrain I would run on (asphalt, track, or mountain). I tried at least 5 or 6 models, feeling the cushioning, fit, and weight of each pair. In the end, I decided on a pair with good support, excellent cushioning, and a color I loved, ready to face miles, sweat, and new goals.
